item.title: UP’s Maharajganj Worker Mustafa Khan Dies in Tragic Kuwait Road Accident
item.description: Mustafa Khan, a resident of Village Gangarai in Maharajganj district, died in a road accident in Kuwait’s Jahra area after a speeding tanker hit him while loading a vehicle. His burial will be performed in Kuwait after Friday prayers.

item.title: Delhi records season’s hottest day at 34°C; IMD warns of further temperature rise
item.description: Delhi experienced its hottest day of the season on Thursday with the maximum temperature reaching 34.3°C, according to the weather department. The rising heat signals an early start to summer-like conditions in the capital.

item.title: Trump warns Iran military to surrender or dace death amid escalating West Asia crisis; Details here
item.description: US President Donald Trump issued a strong warning to Iran’s Revolutionary Guard, military and police, demanding they surrender amid the escalating West Asia conflict. Trump claimed US forces were systematically destroying Iran’s missile and drone capabilities and naval assets.

item.title: US grants 30-day waiver for India to import Russian oil amid global energy concerns; Full details
item.description: The United States has issued a temporary 30-day waiver allowing Indian refiners to purchase Russian oil already stranded at sea. The move aims to maintain global oil supply amid rising tensions in the Persian Gulf and disruptions in energy markets.

item.title: Fresh snowfall likely in Kashmir’s higher reaches next week; Check weather report here
item.description: Kashmir is likely to witness a fresh spell of rain and snowfall after March 10 as a series of western disturbances approach the region. Weather experts say higher reaches and popular tourist destinations such as Gulmarg, Sonamarg and Doodhpathri may receive snowfall, while plains could see moderate to heavy rainfall.

item.title: T20 World Cup 2026: India break Australia’s world record in Semi-Final; Creates history
item.description: India scripted history in the T20 World Cup 2026 semi-final by defeating England by seven runs in a thrilling, high-scoring clash at Wankhede Stadium. Powered by Sanju Samson’s explosive 89 and a strong batting performance, India posted 253 runs. England fought hard but fell short at 246.

item.title: Two IAF pilots killed after Sukhoi Su-30MKI fighter jet crashes in Assam; Click for details
item.description: Two Indian Air Force pilots were killed after a Sukhoi Su-30MKI fighter jet crashed in Assam’s Karbi Anglong district during a training mission. The aircraft had taken off from Jorhat airbase but lost communication shortly after departure around 7:42 pm.

item.title: Market opens lower on Friday; Investors cautious ahead of global cues
item.description: Indian stock markets opened sharply lower on Friday, with Sensex falling over 400 points and Nifty50 slipping below 24,650. ICICI Bank and IndiGo were major drags, while Bank Nifty and midcap indices also declined. Broader markets showed mixed trends, with some smallcap gains.

item.title: MCX Gold surges above Rs 1.61 lakh amid US-Iran tensions; Check prices here
item.description: MCX gold surged above ₹1.61 lakh per 10 grams, while silver jumped 2% to ₹2.68 lakh amid escalating US-Iran conflict. Safe-haven demand, rising oil prices, and global uncertainty boosted bullion prices.

item.title: Bihar Politics: After Nitish Kumar, will son Nishant lead JD(U)? Full update here
item.description: Bihar CM Nitish Kumar’s entry into the Rajya Sabha now appears almost now certain. His move to the Upper House has triggered intense political speculation in Bihar, whether his son, Nishant Kumar, will step forward to take charge of the Janata Dal (United) in the future.
